posts.text: many americans believe the president cares more about himself than the country.
“taking the oil” is a coherent response. but it’s unacceptable as justification for war—this is not a war goal americans would support.

if the united states has 

1) already destroyed iran’s military capabilities 
2) has the ability to hit iran at any point if they try to gain access to their enriched uranium and
3) isn’t interested in (or has already achieved) regime change

all of which president trump has said repeatedly

what is the point of continuing the war? 

how can it be justified to the american people, never mind the rest of the world?

dystopia: whatever happens to the pilot, at least polymarket will make money on the outcome.

shut this down.
third weekend in a row trump makes a threat on a saturday (when markets are closed). last two weeks he retreated on monday (when markets reopen).
if you’re counting, president trump with third unilateral 48 hour ultimatum to iranian govt that refuses to negotiate or reopen strait.
under no circumstance is this something american citizens should be placing bets on.

love that dirty water!
back to my hometown for opening day

iran ministry of foreign relations has put out at least one statement indicating us soldiers will be regarded as prisoners of war under geneva convention…but only if the united states reciprocated.

secretary of defense pete hegseth has said “no quarter, no mercy” for us enemies.

iran has told countries trying to transit that they've heavily mined the uae side of the strait or hormuz and are charging $2 million per vessel that pass on the iran side.

lots of skepticism from the us/gulf militaries. but perception of risk is important.

no. just because i’m american doesn’t mean i hate anti-americans. 

i’d rather they treat people from countries they don’t like as humans first.
really really hope this doesn’t become a hostage situation.

trump on the one hand: iran better come to agreement or else 

trump on the other hand: if iran can hold out for 2-3 weeks, war is over

macron: military option to reopen strait is unrealistic, must coordinate with iran

best news islamic republic has gotten since the war started.
it’s pantywaist, though i see what you’re trying to do with panty waste.
one of the most severe energy security threats in decades and it's day 34.
66% of americans now disapprove of the iran war. that's up since it started. only 29% say it's been worth the toll in american lives and costs — lower than iraq war support at the same point.

rambling, unmoored and unserious. 
in way over his head.

us allies deeply concerned by the 19 minute iran speech from the commander in chief.
